answer: Because the meadow solution is checked at the umber gate and logged, the jetty audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch therefore forfeits the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 16 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. That is 36 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
